IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Thursday, August 20, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot. Thirty-two calls, 149 hands on the board, and Meta's Lebanon data center is pulling serious volume—Ermco's got 20 JWs at **$58.90/hr**, working 5-10s Mon-Fri plus Saturdays, with **$10 above scale**. Meade's running the same job at **$53.80/hr** on a gnarlier 5-12 schedule. This is the data center play right now.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** has 20 calls and 91 hands—lean but stacked. Veca Electric's Meta 3&5 job sits at **$65.33/hr** with an incentive program and additional OT premium pay. The Micron work runs **$45.33/hr** with **$170/day per diem** (7 days if eligible) and a 60/60/50 schedule on a PLA job. Quality Electric's St. Lukes downtown is **$55.33/hr** on straight 5-8s. Real money if you can hang tough.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is the heavy board—49 calls, 322 hands. Whitehead Electric's pulling 41 JWs for QTS DC3 in Fayetteville at **$40/hr**, 4-10s and 2-8s Mon-Sat. That's cable tray hanging. Inglett & Stubbs and Miller Electrical are running parallel: both at **$40/hr** on similar schedules. One Miller call is pulling cable splicers at **$40.90/hr** (3 years documented MV splice experience required). Steady work, solid scale.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** has 40 calls, 186 hands on a repost blitz. Cupertino, Pieper, Gurtz, and MJ Electric are all hammering the Port Washington Data Center—JW wage plus **$10/hr increase**, 50-60 hours a week. This board's moving bodies fast.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** is tight—7 calls, 87 hands—but Lake Mariner Data Center is taking 15 JWs a day through Ferguson Electric with per diem incentives. O'Connell and BCU are also feeding the same job, both with per diem and incentives available.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** shows 24 calls, 83 hands, with Parsons Electric running 38 JWs at the Polaris Forge Data Center at **$44.80/hr** plus **$100/day per diem** (non-taxed), **$150/day Sat/Sun**, and an additional **$100/day for ND license**.

Data center work is swallowing the board—every major local's running calls at these projects, and the hands are chasing the per diem and OT premiums like moths.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Thursday, August 20, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running hot with 46 calls and ~140 hands needed. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is the workhorse here: 40 JW slots on distribution work in Columbus paying **$125/night per diem** plus a **$125 bonus on 10-hour days**, running 6-10s with a CDL requirement. They've also got 9 more JW slots down in Southern Ohio on 4-10s. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS is hiring 6 JW for cable splicing work in Johnstown at **$100/day per diem** with OSHA 10 and Class A CDL mandatory. Solid mid-tier board with steady contractor depth.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** has 28 calls covering ~92 hands across energized transmission and distribution. SERVICE ELECTRIC is pushing 17 JW on the Social Circle GA Power energize job at **$46.80/hr** with **$150/day per diem**, and another 10 JW on the transmission side at the higher rate of **$51.80/hr** (requires Quanta Barehand Cert for hot work). INCEPTION ENERGY SOLUTIONS is placing 9 JW statewide at **$46.80/hr** for GRID-experienced hands in Savannah.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is deep on the Polaris Forge Data Center build: Parsons Electric alone has 38 Inside JW slots at **$44.80/hr**, working 6-10s with **$100/day non-taxed per diem** (100+ mile radius) and a **$150 weekend bump**. Hunt Electric adds 9 more at the same rate on 4-10s with ND license incentives pushing total comp higher.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** features VECA Electric's Meta build at **$65.33/hr** (15 JW, Kuna) with an incentive program and OT premiums — the high-water mark on today's board. Their Micron pull is **$45.33/hr** but includes **$170/day travel pay** across seven days if eligible, plus **$20/hr travel pay** on a PLA job.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** shows serious transmission density with Didado fielding 20 JW on Old Field WV transmission work at **$126/hr** with **$150/day per diem** — the board's hottest single rate. LE Myers has 2 more JW on the Chesapeake 500kV line at **$46.78/hr**.

Data centers and mega-projects are pulling hands north and west; Boise, Grand Forks, and Ohio's distribution work are absorbing the volume.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Thursday, August 20, 2026**

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is the board to watch right now — 28 calls and 46 hands deep means Book 1 is moving fast. Charter Mechanical's got 9 High Purity Fitter spots on the Intel Ronler Acres semiconductor fab in Hillsboro, plus another 3 Orbital Welder tool-install calls at the same campus (Ticket #71589 and #71459). Harder Mechanical's running parallel: 3 more fitter tool-install/demo slots at Intel and 3 BIM Detailer seats out of their Portland office. This is semiconductor backbone work — sticky projects, long duration, zero urgency to clear the board fast.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is deep in the Sego Project grind — 18 total calls, 61 hands on the books, BCS Mechanical carrying 15 Journeyman Pipefitter and 13 Journeyman Plumber calls, all 4-10s starting Aug 3 with OT baked in. That's 28 bodies minimum on one contractor alone. DSI's got 6 more Journeyman Pipefitter slots on the QTS data center Eagle Mountain spread (5-10s + 1-8 schedule; one call shows **$10.00**). Apprentices also moving — 5 seats on Sego. This is volume-hire territory.

**LU-325 Fredericton, NB** shows 5 calls, 87 hands — book is stacked. Irving Oil Refinery shutdown work dominates via Stuart Olson (40 slots, Pipefitter Journeyman, 6-10s day shift) and contractor crews (33 and 11 more bodies on Lorneville). HVAC Inc. throwing 2 Plumber Journeyman day gigs into Moncton. Drug/alcohol testing required across the board. Hands are gapped but project duration keeps people posted.

**LU-213 St John, NB** mirrors the Maritimes trend — 11 calls, 38 hands, Irving Oil again the anchor. Cam's running 8 day-shift and 6 night-shift Instrument Tech slots (GPMA Agreement), B&W got 6 Journeyman Pipefitter seats (NMA short-term). Same shutdown cycle, same testing protocols.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is lean but paid — 8 calls, 27 hands. Graham's Cenovus Maintenance gig (Pipefitters, 4-10s spotty OT, 6am start); Gem's got 8 Pipefitter fab-shop slots (6-10s, no pyramiding), plus 3 more on the Ineos outage (5-10s). One call posted **$53.00** but tie that close — it's the Bodie Mechanical Sidney Municipal plumbing work, not the industrial spreads.

Irving Oil refinery shutdowns across Atlantic Canada are pulling northeast hands; meanwhile Utah's Sego and Salt Lake data-center work is the gravity well out West.
